general.answer-first: Start with the direct answer, then add the explanation and any supporting example.
general.plain-language: Use straightforward, concrete language that is clear on the first read. Preserve technical precision without dense phrasing.
general.explain-mechanism: Connect what happens to why it happens. Explain the relevant technical steps in simple terms rather than replacing the cause with a slogan.
general.focused-code: Use code when it clarifies the explanation. Keep examples focused on the behavior, with brief setup and no unnecessary surrounding program.
general.comparable-aspects: Establish what the compared concepts have in common, then compare the same aspects and state the relevant conditions.
general.no-long-dashes: Do not use em dash or en dash characters in authored prose or responses.
